headline: EQT Healthcare Growth to Acquire Majority Stake in Kelso Pharma
summary: EQT Healthcare Growth is set to acquire a majority stake in Kelso Pharma, a specialty European pharmaceutical group with a commercial platform in the UK.
why: Private equity acquisitions of specialty pharmaceutical firms involve significant capital deployment and reshape competitive dynamics within regional healthcare markets.
